summary: Move tasks across a board, then open one to set its status, assignee and talk it through.
intent: Block: a task board with detail. TaskBoard columns (drag or keyboard moves); a card opens a Drawer with the task, Status and Assignee Fields (Select, Avatar) and its CommentThread.
useWhen: a team's tasks by status, with the detail one click away
change a task's status or assignee without leaving the board
discuss a task in place with replies
doNotUseWhen: a list with filters and sorting — DataTable

columns.note: { id, label, cardIds }[]. A task's column is its status; the last column counts as done in the head.

tasks.note: { id, title, description?, tags?, assigneeId?, dueOn?, comments?: CommentThread comments }[]

people.note: { id, name, initials?, avatarSrc? }[]: assignees and comment authors.

currentUserId.note: Their comments get Edit and Delete.

boardTitle.note: TaskBoard's name, e.g. "Billing Q4". Default: title.

openTaskId.note: Controlled: the task whose drawer is open, or null.

onMove.note: (taskId, toColumnId, index) => void. From the board, or the drawer's Status (to the end of that column). moveWorkBoardTask(columns, …) returns the new columns.

onUpdate.note: (taskId, { assigneeId: string | null }) => void. The drawer's Assignee.

onComment.note: (taskId, body, parentId?) => void. Reply is offered when set.

onAdd.note: (columnId) => void. Add card under a column.

layout: head: h2 title and the task count
body: TaskBoard; its columns are at least 14rem and scroll sideways inside the board when the block is narrow
detail: a right Drawer (lg): description, tags, Status and Assignee Fields stacked (the portaled Drawer is outside layout-content, so a split would not stack at 390), then the CommentThread

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h2 title; place it inside the page's <main>
the board is TaskBoard's: columns are sections with counts, cards are buttons, Space / arrows / Space moves by keyboard with announcements
a card opens a kit Drawer (dialog, focus trap, Escape, focus returns to the card)
Status and Assignee are kit Selects in labelled Fields; the assignee's Avatar is beside its name
the CommentThread is named after the task; Reply shows who you reply to with a Cancel reply button
no motion of its own; the parts' motion is transform and opacity and off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not rebuild WorkBoard from a local Kanban; import the block
Do not make moves drag-only; TaskBoard's keyboard path stays
Do not encode status by colour alone
Only one solid primary in the view: Comment in the open drawer
snippet: <WorkBoard boardTitle="Billing Q4" columns={columns} tasks={tasks} people={people} currentUserId={me.id} onMove={move} onUpdate={update} onComment={comment} />
